title: Snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- base of snow globe -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='30' ry='9' fill='#c98b3e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='9' fill='#e8a84c'/>
  <!-- base highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#f7c96e'/>
  <!-- globe glass sphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='32' fill='#bfe3f5'/>
  <!-- inner glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='28' fill='#e3f4ff'/>
  <!-- snowy ground inside -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='10' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- little house inside -->
  <rect x='42' y='48' width='16' height='13' rx='1' fill='#e85d4a'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='40,49 50,38 60,49' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <!-- snow on roof -->
  <polygon points='40,49 50,38 60,49' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='47' y='54' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='52' y='51' width='4' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#ffd86e'/>
  <!-- smoke from chimney -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#d9e8f2'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='31' r='2' fill='#d9e8f2'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='27' r='1.5' fill='#d9e8f2'/>
  <!-- little pine trees -->
  <polygon points='30,62 34,50 38,62' fill='#3a9e5c'/>
  <polygon points='62,62 66,52 70,62' fill='#2f8a4f'/>
  <!-- tree trunks -->
  <rect x='33' y='62' width='2' height='4' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='65' y='62' width='2' height='4' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- snowflakes inside globe -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='52' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='1.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='62' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <path d='M32 38 Q38 28 50 26' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M62 30 Q66 34 70 42' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- base rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#a86e2c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#d4953f'/>
</svg>
